home.heroTitle: Find a language teacher who gets you talking
home.heroBody: One-on-one video lessons with English, Russian, and more, from teachers across Uzbekistan and beyond. Pay per lesson in so'm.
home.step1Body: Filter by language, price, and focus. Watch a one-minute intro before you commit to anything.
home.step2Body: Pick a slot from the teacher's calendar. Times show in your timezone — no maths to do.
home.step3Body: You get a video link and a reminder. Pay in so'm after the lesson is confirmed, not before.
home.teachBody: Set your own rates and hours. We handle scheduling, payments, and payouts to your card in so'm.
